facts.fact: Packet Clearing House's report of 21 August 2026 lists Guinea-Bissau among 51 countries with no internet exchange point, against 162 countries with one or more.

note: Names exchanges only in Johannesburg, Nairobi and Lagos; Guinea-Bissau appears only in a Starlink availability list, so no exchange fact for GNB.
Announces a PPP tender for a national fibre backbone; no exchange point is mentioned.
Procurement plan lists IXP equipment purchases (two cancelled 2024, one signed 2025); equipment being bought, no networks exchanging traffic stated, so no service fact.
WARDIP is said to be financing an exchange point; none stated in service.
Equipment for the first exchange point is contracted, delivery pending; no exchange in service.
No exchange point in this country stated.
